_purpose: The registry of every GENERATED data artifact + its ONE pure generator (Phase C / blueprint D2). The derived_artifacts_fresh invariant iterates this list: for each entry it re-runs the generator over the sealed pillars and compares to the on-disk artifact, so a hand-edit or a stale build of any listed artifact is un-shippable (R1). eden/tools/build_embeds.py iterates the same list to regenerate. GROWS as Phase C folds each embed into the pipeline (C3: the product embeds).
_contract: Each generator module exposes build_fn() -> the artifact object (pure, no write; used by the freshness gate) and write_fn() -> regenerates the on-disk file via safe_write (used by build_embeds). compare='json' means the gate compares json.loads(disk) == build_fn(); 'text' means exact-text. inputs list the pillar paths the generator reads (documentation + future input-hash tracking).

artifacts.note: The trace/rare-mineral coverage metric (state/coverage.ts esbuild JSON import): goal (Wallach colloidal-mineral dose expressed in mg via composition; cites WAL-CLM-EPIGEN-000089) + per-product plant-derived-mineral vehicle mg. DERIVES from the sealed Products pillar (composition mg) + the curated trace-mineral-vehicles.json (judgment: group/mode/factors/goal-model) + the sealed dose claim (goal). The 33 trace_pdm minerals are scored as ONE group (Sigma regimen pdm_mg / goal.maintenance_mg). build_data() hard-fails via validate() on a missing product or a zero-mg amount-mode product (a silently-missed vehicle pattern). §00.A: composition feeds the math; the goal is a Wallach dose, not a Youngevity target (source-rule review 2026-07-12). Deterministic (sorted keys, NO timestamp) so build_fn byte-compares to disk.

The essential-fatty-acid coverage metric (state/coverage.ts esbuild JSON import): goal (Wallach's ONE EFA amount, 9 g -> 9000 mg, a unit change of his own figure; cites WAL-CLM-DDDL-000115) + per-product EFA mg. GOAL MEMBERSHIP (2026-07-16, the live Coverage build): the skeleton's goals block holds only the CURATION ({id, name, conditions[]} -- ours, editorial, explicitly NOT a Wallach claim; Luneth authors the real set and the 14 shipped are a placeholder he rewrites); each goal's `members` DERIVES here by intersecting the sealed claims against the goal's Catalog condition slugs, so membership is Wallach's and can never be hand-typed (R3) or rot as mining adds claims. search-only claims are excluded (the goal strip is an OPERATIONAL surface). Excluded from membership: the 34 trace_pdm (no individual Wallach amount -- one shared verdict, so a goal can never name one; read from essentials-targets-data's target.kind, the semantic fact) and the 4 fiat-covered foundational slugs (H/C/N/O -- nothing to take, so no goal to set; phosphorus is NOT excluded, its covered traces to a sealed claim). The derive HARD-FAILS on an unresolvable condition slug, a non-canon essential, or a goal with zero members. NO per-goal `total` -- membership is what you LOOK AT, a total is a DENOMINATOR and the denominator is always 90. Gated by goal_members_actionable.

The Search 'Ask-Wallach' index (state/search.ts esbuild JSON import). DERIVES from the two hand-authored SOURCE files -- search-enrichment.json (per-claim subject/facet/question/answer_short/also_about/topics) + the entity registry search-entities.json -- JOINED with the sealed claim (answer = claim_text minus the ' In his words:' tail, byte-faithful; verbatim; page; book_id; tier1_link from the claim's essentials/conditions/symptoms arrays) + books-meta (composed cite) + essentials-canon (canon entity display_name/symbol, so a canonical name is never hand-duplicated). build_index() hard-fails via validate() on a bad facet / subject not in registry-or-canon / unresolved also_about / missing authored field / empty derived answer-or-verbatim (validate() is shared with the search_index_wellformed invariant). Replaces the retired thin-slice drafts (mercury-slice.json + the hand search-entities.json under assets/data/search). Deterministic (sorted) so build_fn byte-compares to disk. The ORAC knowledge tab's canonical numbers (Phase 2, sections 02/03/08), read by views/knowledge-orac.ts via state/orac.ts (esbuild JSON import). Every value is PARSED from a sealed claim's byte-faithful verbatim (dose is null on all 10 source claims), so no ORAC number is hand-typed in a view or in view-copy (R1/R3/SS00.A) -- the numbers live here, the framing prose with {placeholders} lives in view-copy.json. Citations are composed from books-meta + the claim's own locator.page + a verbatim-parsed study/agency attribution (R3), never hand-typed. build_data() HARD-FAILS (ParseError) if a required number is not present in its claim's verbatim -- a silent guess cannot ship, and a verbatim edit that drops a number reddens the board. Deterministic (sorted keys, NO timestamp) so build_fn byte-compares to disk.

The ORAC knowledge tab's food league-table numbers (Phase 3b, sections 04-07), read by views/knowledge-orac.ts via state/orac-foods.ts (esbuild JSON import). Every ORAC score is PARSED from a sealed food_source claim's byte-faithful verbatim (dose is null on all 5: IMMORT-000240/241/263/264 per-serving + HELLS-000014 per-100 g), so no score is hand-typed in a view, in view-copy, or in the curation (R1/R3/SS00.A -- the mineral-tiers lesson). The hand-authored orac-foods-curation.json (accounted, numbers-free) decides only names/grouping/colour/selection; each curated name is a byte-exact join key into a pool. build_data() HARD-FAILS (FoodsError) if a curated name does not resolve OR if any per-serving pool row is neither placed in a category nor omitted (a silent drop reddens the board). The two ORAC bases (per-serving / per-100 g) are kept separate + LABELLED, never mixed. Deterministic (sorted keys, NO timestamp) so build_fn byte-compares to disk.

The ORAC knowledge tab's section-07 'Best Supplement Sources' (Youngevity product ORAC), read by views/knowledge-orac.ts via state/orac-products.ts (esbuild JSON import). These per-serving ORAC scores are YOUNGEVITY OFFICIAL lab values (source: ygy), NOT Wallach numbers and NOT in the corpus -- product ORAC is composition/measured-property data (SS00.A lets Youngevity supply+surface composition; Luneth-confirmed framing 2026-07-24, no source-rule override). Unlike orac-foods there is no sealed verbatim to parse, so the numbers have ONE hand-authored home: orac-products-curation.json (accounted). orac_products_derive.py JOINS each product_id with the sealed product pillar (canonical name + delivery form) and prices.json (wholesale price, by ygy_id); build_data() HARD-FAILS (ProductsError) if a curated product_id has no pillar record, no component form, or no wholesale price -- a silent drop reddens the board. Deterministic (sorted keys, NO timestamp) so build_fn byte-compares to disk.

_accounted_purpose: The COMPLETENESS half of R1 (crack #1 fix, 2026-07-06). derived_artifacts_fresh proves the `artifacts` above are fresh; it does NOT prove the list is complete. The data_artifacts_accounted invariant requires EVERY dashboard/assets/data/*.json to appear either in `artifacts` (derived + freshness-gated) or here in `accounted` (hand-authored or gated by a dedicated invariant), each with a disposition + reason. A data file in neither list is RED -- no silently-added hand-maintained artifact can ship. disposition = hand_authored | externally_gated.
